name: stale_aggregate
description: In the PUT /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber endpoint, the code updates detail rows in lineitem (l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax) but does not recompute or update the parent orders.o_totalprice aggregate. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey endpoint then reads and serves the stored o_totalprice directly from orders, so after a line item change it can return a stale summary value.
